name: Tali Resources Ltd
summary: Tali Resources Ltd explores for and develops minerals in Western Australia, looking at sediment-hosted copper, iron oxide copper-gold, REE-Nb carbonatites, orogenic gold, and critical and precious metals. Its flagship is the wholly owned West Arunta Project, about 4,000 square kilometers. Formerly Tali Resources WA Pty Ltd, it was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Subiaco.
